isolation_test.comparison_rule: Exact bytes for PNG/CSV/Markdown; SVG after canonicalizing opaque generated id attributes and references by occurrence.

methods: Final PNG figures inspected at original resolution corresponding to 17 cm width.
Final Markdown table HTML and CSV content inspected; 17 cm grid previews were checked for row and column alignment, wrapping, and legibility.

deliverables.Figure 1: PASS — intervals, markers, row labels and component annotations are clear; no clipping or overlap.
deliverables.Figure 2: PASS — keys are separated from headings; all non-zero segments are legible inside or beside bars.
deliverables.Figure 3: PASS — population encodings, intervals and annotations are clear; the lower key does not cover data.
deliverables.Figure 4: PASS — all 20 labels are legible; three leader lines are unambiguous; keys and threshold labels are clear.
deliverables.Supplementary Figure S1: PASS — diagnostic header, population encodings and intervals are clear; no clipping or overlap.
deliverables.Supplementary Figure S2: PASS — compact-panel labels and 0/50/100% ticks are separated; keys and diagnostic labels are clear.
deliverables.Supplementary Figure S3: PASS — category icons, keys, percentages and external small-segment labels are clear.
deliverables.Table 1: PASS — spanning headers, row groups and six displayed label rows align; long labels wrap legibly.
deliverables.Table 2: PASS — spanning headers, row groups and four displayed label rows align; minus signs are legible.
deliverables.Table 3: PASS — nine columns, four row groups and all 12 label rows align; counts-only rows are distinct.
deliverables.Table 4: PASS — nine columns, four row groups and all eight label rows align; counts-only rows are distinct.
deliverables.Supplementary Table S1a: PASS — three columns and four response rows align without clipping.
deliverables.Supplementary Table S1b: PASS — three columns and five response rows align without clipping.
deliverables.Supplementary Table S1c: PASS — six columns and four population/dimension rows align; percentages remain legible.
deliverables.Supplementary Table S2: PASS — five columns, two dimension groups and four pair-type rows align.
